text:
Maya (People Ops): FYI rolling out a pilot: Volunteer Time + Donation Matching. Employees can use up to 3 paid volunteer days and submit donation receipts for 1:1 match (pilot countries: US, UK, DE). Requirements: manager attestation in portal + e-sign + completion of 20-min compliance microtraining. Draft policy: https://handbook.internal.redwood/policies/volunteer-donation-pilot-v1 :seedling:

Rafael (Payroll): Payroll needs the transaction code for matched donations and a payroll journal mapping. Also need the list of attested managers each pay period to avoid accidental gross-up.

Maya (People Ops): Noted. We'll surface a manager_attested boolean in the export. Proposed payroll mapping: account 4201 for donation matches (non-taxable in UK/DE? Sana?)

Sana (Legal): UK/DE have different tax treatments. Donation match may be taxable in some jurisdictions. We need legal opinion for DE and a payroll flag to indicate taxability per region. Also check worker council notification requirements in DE.

Ethan (Manager): Quick ask: can managers batch attest for recurring volunteer programs, or must they confirm each event? For recurring team-run charity shifts it's noisy to approve every time.

Maya (People Ops): We'll support recurring event templates with manager bulk attest. The portal will show event_id and recurrence boolean. Recurring attestments will still record timestamps for audit.

training-bot: New microlearning assigned: "Volunteer & Donation Matching - Compliance (15m)" due in 21 days to be able to claim days.

Maya (People Ops): For auditing and payroll exports, example CLI/SQL below. Rafael, we'll add taxability flag and country_code to the export.

```
# HR export
python hr_tools/export.py --name volunteer_donation_claims --start 2026-05-01 --end 2026-06-30 --format csv > /tmp/vd_claims.csv

# BigQuery quick check
SELECT employee_id, country_code, event_id, recurring, manager_id, manager_attested, attested_at, donation_amount, payroll_taxable_flag
FROM `redwood-hr.prod.volunteer_donation_claims`
WHERE submitted_at BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-06-30';
```

Rafael (Payroll): Perfect. I'll add the account mappings and tax flags. Will need a sample CSV to validate with payroll system before first run.

i18n-team: We can translate the policy and the notification emails for UK/DE in ~4 business days after final copy. Please tag with region-specific legal notes so translators can avoid ambiguous wording.

Sana (Legal): I'll draft short region notes for DE/UK about taxability and worker council steps. Will ping when ready.

Ethan (Manager): Can we get a manager dashboard widget that surfaces pending attestations per team? Saves a lot of back-and-forth.

Maya (People Ops): Good idea 10. We'll scope a simple widget for the manager portal showing pending attestations and microtraining completion. ETA: 2 sprints.

Maya (People Ops): Action items: 1) Sana to deliver region notes by Wed. 2) Rafael to validate payroll mapping with sample CSV by Fri. 3) i18n to queue translations after text freeze. 4) People Ops to schedule two 30-min drop-in Q&A sessions (EMEA/NA) next week and publish the claims tracker sheet. I'll post the tracker link here once created.

training-bot: Reminder scheduled: Microlearning "Volunteer & Donation Matching - Compliance" assigned to all employees in pilot regions. Due in 21 days.

Maya (People Ops): Tracker link: https://docs.internal.redwood/people-ops/vd-pilot-tracker (managers: please update attestations column after approval). I'll upload sample export to the payroll QA bucket by tomorrow morning. Thanks! :tada:
